name: @sweny-ai/core
stderr:
Usage: sweny [options] [command]

Workflows for coding agents. One set of rules, a receipt for every run.

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  new [options] [id]             Create a new workflow. With no id, opens the
                                 interactive picker. With an id, uses that
                                 built-in template.
  try [options]                  Replay a recorded real run: no credentials, no
                                 network, no model calls
  check                          Verify provider credentials and connectivity
  setup                          Create the standard SWEny label set in your
                                 issue tracker or source control provider
  publish [options] [run-id]     Publish a workflow or skill to the SWEny
                                 Marketplace; with a run id, send the writes
                                 that run froze for approval
  skill                          Author and inspect skills
  triage [options]               Run the SWEny triage workflow
  implement [options] <issueId>  Implement a fix for a specific issue and open a
                                 PR
  workflow                       Manage and run workflow files
  runs [options]                 List recent workflow runs recorded in
                                 .sweny/runs/ (metadata only)
  upgrade|update [options]       Upgrade sweny to the latest published version
  help [command]                 display help for command
